definitions.paired: Identical authored history and learner text for every compared profile; hashes permit direct verification.
definitions.rollout: Same scripted learner lines but each profile appends its own emitted tutor. Contexts diverge. A scripted line may not answer that profile's actual preceding question; inspect the full chain.
definitions.firstJapaneseAudioEmittedMs: Recognized authored text to first complete validated WAV, excluding capture, ASR, transport and playback.
definitions.responseDoneMs: Observed server permission to finish response delivery; client also waits for its audio queue.
definitions.respondReturnedMs: Return of the response function; does not imply secondary work has settled.
definitions.allObservedWorkSettledMs: Return plus observed real details callbacks settled and their microtask metrics published. Not a GPU-idle measurement.
definitions.estimatedListeningGateMs: Ideal sequential WAV playback from arrival times, gated by response_done; no network, decode, Android player or human observation.
definitions.estimatedHoldAfterLastWaveMs: Positive response_done minus ideal last WAV end. Secondary delay risk estimate, not actual microphone latency.
definitions.checks: Mechanical expectations and lexical warning patterns; no automatic Japanese, translation or conversational correctness verdict.

history.content: 何が好きですか？
Je ne sais pas. Aide-moi à répondre.
Tu peux dire ce que tu aimes avec ga suki desu. 日本語が好きです。
日本語が好きです。
日本語が好きなんですね。どんな飲み物が好きですか？
えっと…コーヒー…じゃなくて、お茶が好きです。
お茶が好きなんですね。温かいお茶は好きですか？

reply.japanese: コーヒーが好きではありません。
reply.romaji: Kōhī ga suki de wa arimasen.
reply.french: Je ne t'aime pas le café.
